meta.title: OpenScreenShot vs GoFullPage vs FullPage Capture
meta.description: A factual comparison of the three full page screenshot extensions: store status, open source, standing site access, one-click capture, free annotation, PDF, and tab recording.

label: Compare
heading: OpenScreenShot vs GoFullPage vs FullPage Capture
lead: GoFullPage is back in the Chrome Web Store after a removal in August 2026, and it now ships for Firefox too, but its code has been private since 2018. OpenScreenShot is the open-source full page screenshot you can audit. FullPage Capture is a closed extension that asks for access to every website at install.
asOf: Facts as of 9 Oct 2026, from each store listing, each extension's manifest, and the vendors' own sites. GoFullPage's private fork since 2018 is from its own FAQ.

rows.gfp: Yes, restored 10 Sep 2026 after an August removal
